name: Concrete masonry block, painted/sealed
source: Standard architectural-acoustics coefficient tables (ISO 354 / ASTM C423 measured).
notes: Lightweight concrete masonry unit (cinder/breeze block) with the surface pores sealed by paint — reflective. Not the same as solid/cast concrete, which is lower still (~0.01–0.05; see “Concrete or terrazzo floor”).

name: Concrete masonry block, coarse/unpainted
source: Standard architectural-acoustics coefficient tables (ISO 354 / ASTM C423 measured).
notes: This is coarse, open-pored LIGHTWEIGHT concrete masonry block (cinder/breeze block) — NOT solid or cast concrete. Its rough porous surface makes it a genuine mid-band absorber; sealing or painting the pores collapses it to ~0.05 (see the painted row). Solid/dense concrete is reflective (~0.01–0.05, consistent with DIN 18041; see “Concrete or terrazzo floor”) — do not use these figures for a poured-concrete wall. These are nominal aggregated table values (architectural-acoustics/Beranek lineage), not an in-hand primary test report: cross-check the PTB database and verify against the specific block before relying on them for design.

name: Wood slat panel on PET felt, 21 mm, on wall
source: Riverbank Acoustical Laboratories (NVLAP 100227-0), ASTM C423-22 reports RAL-A23-083 (A mounting) and RAL-A23-086 (C-25 mounting), 2023, ECOScapes Slat Wall — https://www.primacoustic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/ECOScapes-Slat-Wall-ASTM-C423-A-Mount-05_2023.pdf and https://www.primacoustic.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/ECOScapes-Slat-Wall-ASTM-C423-C25-Mount-Telafill-05_2023.pdf
notes: Veneered MDF slats (12.8 mm) over 9.2 mm PET felt, laid directly on the backing (ASTM E795 type A). Lab report RAL-A23-083 publishes −0.01 at 125 Hz and 1.09 at 2 kHz; stored here as 0.00 and 1.00, the same 0–1 convention as the other rows (lab NRC 0.55, unchanged). Almost nothing below 500 Hz: on a wall, a slat panel is a high-frequency absorber.
mounting: Mounted directly against the wall, no air space behind.

name: Wood slat panel, 21 mm, on 25 mm battens, cavity filled

notes: The same slat panel on 25 mm furring strips at 610 mm centres, cavity filled with 25 mm PET felt (ASTM E795 type C-25). Lab report RAL-A23-086 publishes 1.06 at 1 kHz; stored as 1.00, so the NRC computed here is 0.85 where the lab reports 0.90. mounting: On 25 mm battens at 610 mm centres; the 25 mm cavity is filled with PET felt.
